description: Agent 记忆不是一块无限扩张的数据库，而是一套决定什么值得保留、何时取回、怎样遗忘的机制。
descriptionEn: Agent memory is not an infinitely growing database, but a mechanism for deciding what to retain, retrieve, and forget.

description: 为模型组织当下所需的指令、工具、历史、状态和证据，使它在正确边界内完成任务。
descriptionEn: Organising the instructions, tools, history, state, and evidence a model needs to act within the right boundaries.

description: 让 Agent 的行动权限随风险、信任与可逆性逐步增长，而不是在全自动和全手动之间二选一。
descriptionEn: Letting agent authority grow with risk, trust, and reversibility instead of choosing between fully automatic and fully manual.

description: 一个把个人网站、知识图谱与可追溯设计系统结合起来的持续实验。
descriptionEn: An ongoing experiment combining a personal site, a knowledge graph, and a traceable design system.

description: 一个把主题探索变成可生长、可修剪知识树的 AI 工具，让研究过程像植物一样展开。
descriptionEn: An AI knowledge-exploration tool that turns a topic into a tree users can grow, prune, and curate.

description: 以仓库中的正式猫头鹰图标与海报里的 8 字记忆回环为核心，把本地优先的 AI 记忆产品、印刷物与知识空间连接成一套可追溯系统。
descriptionEn: A traceable system led by the repository's official owl and the poster's figure-eight memory loop, connecting a local-first AI memory product, its print artifacts, and its knowledge space.

description: 一个本地优先的 AI 对话记忆层，自动捕获、组织和检索散落在不同模型里的工作脉络。
descriptionEn: A local-first memory layer that captures, organises, and retrieves AI conversations across models.

description: 一个把抽象观点转译成原创手绘解释图的 Codex Skill，根据传播问题选择构图，而不是套用固定模板。
descriptionEn: A Codex skill that translates abstract ideas into original hand-drawn explainers, adapting composition to the communication problem.

description: 从接近正午到傍晚的一次步行：建筑缝隙、树荫、交通与城市表面的短暂秩序。
descriptionEn: A walk from late morning into evening, tracing gaps, shade, traffic, and temporary order across the city.

description: 跨越一年记录的树：枝条、树皮与树冠在海风、冬季和内陆柔光中呈现不同的生长语言。
descriptionEn: A year of tree studies in which branches, bark, and canopy speak differently through salt air, winter, and softer inland light.
